one_liner: B2B customer support platform unifying shared Slack/Teams/email/chat into a single ticketing system.

auth.notes: Core REST API uses admin-issued Bearer API tokens (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN) per api docs; the newer MCP server uses OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit) acting on behalf of the authenticated user. Note: usepylon.com is unrelated to the crypto/x402 'Pylon AI' product found in some search results for 'pylon mcp'.

access.notes: Pricing page offers only a sales demo booking form, no visible self-serve signup or published pricing. Third-party sources disagree on whether a free trial exists.

api.evidence_quote: Expose Pylon data to AI tools and assistants via Model Context Protocol.
api.notes: Official MCP server, configured from Settings > AI Controls > MCP Server in the Pylon dashboard, covering issues, accounts, and contacts.

verdict.rationale: No self-serve signup was found; access appears gated behind a sales demo, though an official MCP server exists once inside.
